prompt:
Create a new KFB claymation ink blob monster sheet for The Inner Cast, Jung-inspired archetype figures. Supplied original images are style references for soft full continuous charcoal-plum ink blob shapes and handcrafted props. Six individually distinct complete upright footless blobs in three columns and two rows, landscape 1536x1024, true transparent PNG. Equal substantial scale, generous clear transparent gutters and margins, all props inside the cell and attached or held. Thick rounded goo bodies, short ink hands, distinct facial shapes and expressions, ivory white sclera, red iris and black pupil, filled modeled eyelids, teeth behind lips. Large soft modeling marks, gentle satin plasticine with very sparse fine grain, broad fabric folds, clear glass and smooth plastic. Keep dominant ink bodies and period or symbolic accessories small. No copied wings, eyepatches or reference costumes. No floor, scene, text, labels, shadows, frame, branding, graphic distress or caricature of illness. Gentle surreal satire of habits, theory and bureaucracy. Color and craft direction: Mask ivory, shadow indigo, terracotta, tarnished gold and moss. Row-major cast:
1. Female-read polished public face. small smiling ivory stage mask held beside the visible real face. upright elegant curl, doubtful sideways eyes, closed uncertain lips.
2. Male-read quiet keeper of disowned things. rounded dark indigo mantle and a tiny discarded golden button. low broad splat, upward apologetic eyes, subtle frown.
3. Male-read playful rule bender. two mismatched dice tucked under one hand and crooked cap. bent tall splat, one cheek raised, uneven grin.
4. Female-read sturdy nurturing figure. small blanket folded around a clay seed, independent hand-held prop. soft round broad body, warm lids and calm smile.
5. Male-read patient guide. short worn staff with a small amber lantern firmly attached. tall leaning blob, squint and creased closed lips.
6. Male-read relieved integrator. four-color mandala medallion held at belly. large low almost circular blob, quietly delighted asymmetrical smile.
Exactly six unique freestanding cutouts. Make the main motif of each slot legible at small sizes.
